trans-unit.source: Requires existing C01 in recipe version 0, positive net quantities in posted and base units, positive recipe cost, an item priority from 1 to 5 and a configured priority percentage. Ineligible lines stay visible without allocation; a business without eligible lines keeps its fund pending. Recalculation reads the final manual cost from structure cost C01 of the recipe, as an amount or a percentage; it does not apply anything to recipes.
